video_title: Karl-Anthony Towns SILENCE Haters with NBA Title?!?

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox on his shooting struggles and team sacrifice
quotes.excerpt: As a player, you sacrifice for the betterment of the team.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: I mean, I have to make shots. That's the only thing that I think is different at times, but obviously I'm not shooting the ball as much. Coming here, I knew that was the way it was going to be. As a player, you sacrifice for the betterment of the team. There are times where I need to take shots, there are times where I don't take as many shots, but at the end of the day, you need to make the shots that you take.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: That's not rocket science. He got really good looks and just didn't make jump shots, especially early on. Obviously, what makes him better is his explosiveness, his speed in transition, and that ankle still is 100 percent, but he still can find ways to be productive. It was just as simple as him not making shots. He got really good looks. I think he knocks those down tonight.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on De'Aaron Fox's difficult transition to San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: You're the veteran guy. You've been the 1A guy a lot of your career.
quotes.quote: Coming to San Antonio was kind of a tricky thing. You're the veteran guy. You've been the 1A guy a lot of your career, but then you come here and now you have Victor Wembanyama that they're trying to make sure he is the focal point. And then you got all these young guys that are emerging. Stephon Castle, rookie of the year guy. They're investing in Stephon Castle. Dylan Harper is way ahead of schedule. Now you got this veteran guard that's kind of in limbo right there in the middle. He's not getting the attempts that he's used to. He can't really shoot himself out of some of these slumps because he don't have the attempts that he's used to. He's in a tricky position, but I love the mindset. I'm just here to do anything positive that I can for the betterment of this basketball team and understanding that this all isn't about me.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on Mitch Johnson's rotation and Dylan Harper's readiness
quotes.excerpt: The moment will never be too big for Dylan Harper.
quotes.quote: I think it's a feel thing. Mitch Johnson has done a great job with this team and with this whole process and fitting in all this depth and this talent and how to make it work. If it's the same thing again and De'Aaron Fox is missing shots and he's struggling, sure, I think you go to the rookie. If he's got the hot hand again, then you stick with him maybe a little longer and you extend your rotations. The moment will never be too big for Dylan Harper. I think Mitch Johnson knows that. I think he'll learn from that and adjust accordingly if it comes to that.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the importance of getting De'Aaron Fox involved early
quotes.excerpt: Maybe I do need to draw up the first one for De'Aaron Fox.
quotes.quote: In Game 1, the first play for the Knicks was for Jalen Brunson. The first play for the Spurs was for Victor Wembanyama. This game, now you can kind of understand, maybe I do need to draw up the first one for De'Aaron Fox. Maybe get an early layup for him, create some opportunities for him where he can get involved in this game early, where we're not in the second quarter and now he's pressing trying to find a rhythm so late in this game. Try to get him going early on and now he's an added asset as opposed to having to pick which one of the assets you want to use.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on Jalen Brunson's status as the Knicks' best player
quotes.excerpt: This team is nothing without Jalen Brunson. I truly believe that.
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns is an unbelievable player. I think Jalen Brunson is by far their best player, by far had the snake that they go as far as he goes. Yes, Karl-Anthony Towns can have games like he did in Game 1, but this team is nothing without Jalen Brunson. I truly believe that. He is their everything. He is their starter, he is their closer, he is their best player. He is fearless, he is tough. He is everything you want in your go-to player. Now for them to be a championship team, which they're looking like it, Karl-Anthony Towns has to be great. OG Anunoby has to be great, which he was. Their bench has to be good, which they've been pretty solid compared to years in the past with Tom Thibodeau in New York, but Jalen Brunson is to me 1,000 percent the head of the snake.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on Josh Hart's rebounding impact
quotes.excerpt: I get rebounds that break teams back.
quotes.quote: If Josh Hart sniffed 15 points, we wouldn't even be having this conversation. He had 15 rebounds and six assists, but he only had three points. I seen something online yesterday, he was talking to Mitchell Robinson and said, 'You get rebounds, I get rebounds that break teams back.' And seeing them win yesterday, every offensive rebound that he got were big, big plays. So we can make a case for anybody outside of it, but as long as Jalen Brunson is having 30-point games, whether it's on 30 attempts or not, it's still going to be his to lose if they win this series.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on Karl-Anthony Towns' inconsistency as a player
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns is a roller coaster, man. You never know what you're going to get.
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns is a roller coaster, man. You never know what you're going to get. Karl-Anthony Towns has been pretty consistent. Karl-Anthony Towns has always been very, very good defensively. He's been at the top, he's won a championship last year. He's been on a very relevant situation as the number two. We always talk about, can this guy be the number two option on a championship team? Karl-Anthony Towns was, and maybe three with Jaylen Williams, but Karl-Anthony Towns hasn't done that yet. Now he's showing us that he can, and he's showing in the finals where it matters most, he's playing his best basketball. So I think Karl-Anthony Towns has always been that most talented guy. Obviously he can shoot the ball. He's always been a very versatile big. I just think the impact of Karl-Anthony Towns on both sides of the floor and the way he can handle on his size and length, it's definitely a conversation. But currently today, I'd have to take Karl-Anthony Towns.
